 439	## Consumer Groups
 440	
 441	Consumer groups provide load balancing and fault tolerance by distributing messages among multiple consumer instances.
 442	
 443	### Basic Consumer Group Setup
 444	
 445	```java
 446	public class ConsumerGroupExample {
 447	
 448	 public void demonstrateBasicConsumerGroup(QueueFactory factory) throws Exception {
 449	 // Create consumer group for order processing
 450	 ConsumerGroup<OrderEvent> orderGroup = factory.createConsumerGroup(
 451	 "OrderProcessing", "order-events", OrderEvent.class);
 452	
 453	 // Add multiple consumers to the group
 454	 orderGroup.addConsumer("consumer-1",
 455	 createLoadBalancedHandler("Consumer-1"),
 456	 message -> true); // Accept all messages
 457	
 458	 orderGroup.addConsumer("consumer-2",
 459	 createLoadBalancedHandler("Consumer-2"),
 460	 message -> true);
 461	
 462	 orderGroup.addConsumer("consumer-3",
 463	 createLoadBalancedHandler("Consumer-3"),
 464	 message -> true);
 465	
 466	 // Start the consumer group
 467	 orderGroup.start();
 468	
 469	 System.out.printf("Started consumer group with %d active consumers%n",
 470	 orderGroup.getActiveConsumerCount());
 471	
 472	 // Monitor group statistics
 473	 monitorConsumerGroup(orderGroup);
 474	 }
 475	
 476	 private MessageHandler<OrderEvent> createLoadBalancedHandler(String consumerId) {
 477	 AtomicLong processedCount = new AtomicLong(0);
 478	
 479	 return message -> {
 480	 return CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(() -> {
 481	 try {
 482	 OrderEvent event = message.getPayload();
 483	 long count = processedCount.incrementAndGet();
 484	
 485	 System.out.printf("[%s] Processing order %s (total: %d)%n",
 486	 consumerId, event.getOrderId(), count);
 487	
 488	 // Simulate processing time
 489	 Thread.sleep(100 + (int)(Math.random() * 200));
 490	
 491	 return null;
 492	 } catch (InterruptedException e) {
 493	 Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
 494	 throw new RuntimeException(e);
 495	 }
 496	 });
 497	 };
 498	 }
 499	
 500	 private void monitorConsumerGroup(ConsumerGroup<OrderEvent> group) {
 501	 ScheduledExecutorService monitor = Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor();
 502	
 503	 monitor.scheduleAtFixedRate(() -> {
 504	 System.out.printf("Consumer Group Stats - Active: %d, Total Processed: %d, Failed: %d%n",
 505	 group.getActiveConsumerCount(),
 506	 group.getTotalMessagesProcessed(),
 507	 group.getTotalMessagesFailed());
 508	 }, 5, 5, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
 509	 }
 510	}

 666	```java

 669	 public void demonstrateCompositeRouting(QueueFactory factory) throws Exception {
 670	 ConsumerGroup<OrderEvent> compositeGroup = factory.createConsumerGroup(
 671	 "CompositeRouting", "order-events", OrderEvent.class);
 672	
 673	 // AND logic - all conditions must be true
 674	 compositeGroup.addConsumer("premium-us-high-value",
 675	 createCompositeHandler("PREMIUM-US-HIGH-VALUE"),

 689	 ));
 690

 695

 822	```java
 823	public class MessageGroupRouting {
 824	
 825	 public void demonstrateMessageGroupRouting(MessageProducer<OrderEvent> producer) {
 826	 // Send related messages with same message group for ordering
 827	 Map<String, String> headers = Map.of(
 828	 "region", "US",
 829	 "customer-tier", "PREMIUM"
 830	 );
 831	
 832	 String customerId = "customer-123";
 833	 String correlationId = "order-session-" + System.currentTimeMillis();
 834	
 835	 // These messages will be processed in order for this customer
 836	 producer.send(
 837	 new OrderEvent("ORD-001", "CREATED", 1000.0, customerId),
 838	 headers, correlationId, customerId);
 839	
 840	 producer.send(
 841	 new OrderEvent("ORD-001", "VALIDATED", 1000.0, customerId),
 842	 headers, correlationId, customerId);
 843	
 844	 producer.send(
 845	 new OrderEvent("ORD-001", "PAYMENT_PROCESSED", 1000.0, customerId),
 846	 headers, correlationId, customerId);
 847	
 848	 producer.send(
 849	 new OrderEvent("ORD-001", "SHIPPED", 1000.0, customerId),
 850	 headers, correlationId, customerId);
 851	 }
 852	
 853	 public void createCorrelationAwareConsumer(QueueFactory factory) throws Exception {
 854	 ConsumerGroup<OrderEvent> correlationGroup = factory.createConsumerGroup(
 855	 "CorrelationAware", "order-events", OrderEvent.class);
 856	
 857	 correlationGroup.addConsumer("correlation-processor",
 858	 createCorrelationHandler(),
 859	 message -> true);
 860	
 861	 correlationGroup.start();
 862	 }
 863	
 864	 private MessageHandler<OrderEvent> createCorrelationHandler() {
 865	 Map<String, List<OrderEvent>> correlationGroups = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
 866	
 867	 return message -> {
 868	 OrderEvent event = message.getPayload();
 869	 String correlationId = message.getHeaders().get("correlation-id");
 870	
 871	 if (correlationId != null) {
 872	 correlationGroups.computeIfAbsent(correlationId, k -> new ArrayList<>())
 873	 .add(event);
 874	
 875	 System.out.printf("Added order %s to correlation group %s%n",
 876	 event.getOrderId(), correlationId);
 877	
 878	 // Process when we have a complete order lifecycle
 879	 List<OrderEvent> group = correlationGroups.get(correlationId);
 880	 if (isCompleteOrderLifecycle(group)) {
 881	 processCompleteOrderLifecycle(correlationId, group);
 882	 correlationGroups.remove(correlationId);
 883	 }
 884	 }
 885	
 886	 return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(null);
 887	 };
 888	 }
 889	
 890	 private boolean isCompleteOrderLifecycle(List<OrderEvent> events) {
 891	 Set<String> statuses = events.stream()
 892	 .map(OrderEvent::getStatus)
 893	 .collect(Collectors.toSet());
 894	
 895	 return statuses.containsAll(Set.of("CREATED", "VALIDATED", "PAYMENT_PROCESSED", "SHIPPED"));
 896	 }
 897	
 898	 private void processCompleteOrderLifecycle(String correlationId, List<OrderEvent> events) {
 899	 System.out.printf("Processing complete order lifecycle for correlation %s%n", correlationId);
 900	 events.forEach(event ->
 901	 System.out.printf(" %s: %s%n", event.getStatus(), event.getOrderId()));
 902	 }
 903	}

 947	public class ConfigurationBasedRouting {

 966	 private void createConfiguredConsumerGroups(QueueFactory factory) throws Exception {
 967	 // Get all configured consumer groups
 968	 Set<String> groupNames = routingConfig.stringPropertyNames().stream()
 969	 .filter(key -> key.startsWith("peegeeq.consumer.groups."))
 970	 .map(key -> key.split("\\.")[3])
 971	 .collect(Collectors.toSet());
 972	
 973	 for (String groupName : groupNames) {
 974	 int maxConsumers = Integer.parseInt(
 975	 routingConfig.getProperty("peegeeq.consumer.groups." + groupName + ".max-consumers", "1"));
 976	
 977	 ConsumerGroup<OrderEvent> group = factory.createConsumerGroup(
 978	 groupName, "order-events", OrderEvent.class);
 979	
 980	 // Create configured number of consumers
 981	 for (int i = 1; i <= maxConsumers; i++) {
 982	 String consumerId = groupName + "-consumer-" + i;
 983	 group.addConsumer(consumerId,
 984	 createConfiguredHandler(groupName, consumerId),
 985	 createConfiguredFilter(groupName));
 986	 }
 987	
 988	 group.start();
 989	 System.out.printf("Started consumer group '%s' with %d consumers%n",
 990	 groupName, maxConsumers);
 991	 }

 1139	
 1140	 if (batch.size() >= batchSize) {
 1141	 List<OrderEvent> currentBatch = new ArrayList<>(batch);
 1142	 batch.clear();
 1143	
 1144	 return CompletableFuture.runAsync(() -> {
 1145	 System.out.printf("[%s] Processing batch of %d orders%n",
 1146	 handlerName, currentBatch.size());
 1147	 // Batch processing logic

 1150	 }

 1152	 return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(null);

 1158	### Best Practices Summary
 1159	
 1160	1. **Filter Efficiency**: Place most selective filters first
 1161	2. **Pre-compilation**: Compile complex filters once and reuse
 1162	3. **Caching**: Cache expensive filter computations
 1163	4. **Batch Processing**: Group related messages for batch processing
 1164	5. **Load Balancing**: Distribute load evenly across consumer instances
 1165	6. **Monitoring**: Track routing decisions and consumer performance
 1166	7. **Configuration**: Use external configuration for routing rules
 1167	8. **Graceful Degradation**: Handle consumer failures gracefully
 1168	
 1169	This comprehensive routing system enables sophisticated message distribution patterns suitable for enterprise-scale applications while maintaining high performance and reliability.
